description: This file defines the AWS KMS (Key Management Service) client class, which provides methods to interact with AWS KMS, including cryptographic operations, key management, and key rotation. It utilizes PHP namespaces, class inheritance, and docblock annotations for method definitions.

classes.name: KmsClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with AWS KMS, extending the AWS SDK's generic AWSClient base class, and providing specific methods for encryption, decryption, key management, and other KMS operations.

methods.name: cancelKeyDeletion
methods.description: Cancels the deletion of a customer master key (CMK).

methods.name: connectCustomKeyStore
methods.description: Connects to a custom key store.

methods.name: createAlias
methods.description: Creates an alias for a customer master key.

methods.name: createCustomKeyStore
methods.description: Creates a new custom key store.

methods.name: createGrant
methods.description: Adds a grant to a customer master key.

methods.name: createKey
methods.description: Creates a new customer master key.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts ciphertext that was encrypted with an AWS KMS key.

methods.name: deleteAlias
methods.description: Deletes the specified alias.

methods.name: deleteCustomKeyStore
methods.description: Deletes a custom key store.

methods.name: deleteImportedKeyMaterial
methods.description: Deletes imported key material.

methods.name: deriveSharedSecret
methods.description: Derives a shared secret using a customer master key.

methods.name: describeCustomKeyStores
methods.description: Provides information about custom key stores.

methods.name: describeKey
methods.description: Provides detailed information about a customer master key.

methods.name: disableKey
methods.description: Marks a customer master key (CMK) as disabled.

methods.name: disableKeyRotation
methods.description: Disables automatic key rotation for the specified customer master key.

methods.name: disconnectCustomKeyStore
methods.description: Disconnects a custom key store.

methods.name: enableKey
methods.description: Re-enables a customer master key that was previously disabled.

methods.name: enableKeyRotation
methods.description: Enables automatic rotation of the specified customer master key.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts plaintext using a customer master key.

methods.name: generateDataKey
methods.description: Generates a unique data key for client-side encryption.

methods.name: generateDataKeyPair
methods.description: Generates a data key pair.

methods.name: generateDataKeyPairWithoutPlaintext
methods.description: Generates a data key pair without returning the plaintext key.

methods.name: generateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
methods.description: Generates a data key without returning the plaintext key material.

methods.name: generateMac
methods.description: Generates a Message Authentication Code (MAC) for a message.

methods.name: generateRandom
methods.description: Returns a random byte string of specified length.

methods.name: getKeyPolicy
methods.description: Retrieves the key policy for a customer master key.

methods.name: getKeyRotationStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the rotation status of a customer master key.

methods.name: getParametersForImport
methods.description: Returns the necessary parameters for importing key material.

methods.name: getPublicKey
methods.description: Returns the public key of an asymmetric CMK.

methods.name: importKeyMaterial
methods.description: Imports key material.

methods.name: listAliases
methods.description: Lists customer master keys (CMKs) and their aliases.

methods.name: listGrants
methods.description: Lists all grants for a specified customer master key.

methods.name: listKeyPolicies
methods.description: Lists key policies attached to a CMK.

methods.name: listKeyRotations
methods.description: Lists key rotation status for all your Customer Master Keys.

methods.name: listKeys
methods.description: Lists all customer master keys (CMKs).

methods.name: listResourceTags
methods.description: Lists tags for a specified resource.

methods.name: listRetirableGrants
methods.description: Lists grants that are available to retire.

methods.name: putKeyPolicy
methods.description: Attaches a key policy to a customer master key.

methods.name: reEncrypt
methods.description: Re-encrypts ciphertext that was encrypted with an encrypted customer master key.

methods.name: replicateKey
methods.description: Replicates a CMK from the primary to a replica key.

methods.name: retireGrant
methods.description: Retires a grant.

methods.name: revokeGrant
methods.description: Revokes a grant.

methods.name: rotateKeyOnDemand
methods.description: Rotates a customer master key on demand.

methods.name: scheduleKeyDeletion
methods.description: Schedules a customer master key (CMK) for deletion.

methods.name: sign
methods.description: Generates a digital signature for a message.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Adds or overwrites tags on a resource.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: updateAlias
methods.description: Updates an alias to point to a different customer master key.

methods.name: updateCustomKeyStore
methods.description: Updates properties of a custom key store.

methods.name: updateKeyDescription
methods.description: Updates the description of a customer master key.

methods.name: updatePrimaryRegion
methods.description: Updates the primary Region for a multi-Region key.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies a digital signature.

methods.name: verifyMac
methods.description: Verifies a message authentication code (MAC).
